**Update below:** I had my tooth re-filled because the dentist said the old filling was worn out. The filling was done around December 27-28, 2021. About a month later, around February 5-6, 2022, I experienced sensitivity at the filling site. I'm not sure what caused it. I called the clinic, and the staff said there might be additional charges if it remained unresolved for more than a month. So I decided it's better not to go back there.

I usually go to The Dent clinic near Ratchayothin BTS station, but they were fully booked at the end of the year, so I ended up at this clinic instead. I'm so disappointed because I didn't want to have to get dental work done multiple times. This was a really upsetting experience.

**Update:** The clinic called and offered a free fix. It's now been two weeks. The dentist trimmed the filling because it was too high initially, causing my teeth to rub against each other and resulting in sensitivity and pain.

I'm now monitoring the situation to see if the sensitivity and pain return. After the fix, there's still some sensitivity, but it's normal and not as severe as before.
